description: This file defines a validation pipeline behavior class for MediatR requests, which uses FluentValidation validators to validate incoming requests and throws an exception if validation failures occur.

classes.name: ValidationPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>
classes.description: Implements a pipeline behavior for MediatR to validate requests using injected FluentValidation validators before proceeding with request handling.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Executes validation logic on the request; throws ValidationException if validation fails; otherwise, calls the next delegate.
